// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 🎨 Translator type — matches next-intl's TFunction shape
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
export type EmailTranslator = (
  key: string,
  values?: Record<string, string | number>
) => string;

// ─── ألوان هوية Lumière ───
const colors = {
  bg: "#faf7f2",
  card: "#ffffff",
  accent: "#c9a961",
  accentDark: "#a88847",
  text: "#1a1a1a",
  muted: "#6b6b6b",
  border: "#e5ddd0",
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 🌐 Locale → BCP-47 date locale mapping
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
function getDateLocale(locale: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    ar: "ar-EG",
    en: "en-US",
    fr: "fr-FR",
    de: "de-DE",
    es: "es-ES",
    it: "it-IT",
    zh: "zh-CN",
  };
  return map[locale] ?? locale;
}

function formatLocalizedDate(date: Date, locale: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(getDateLocale(locale), {
    weekday: "long",
    year: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    day: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: true,
  }).format(date);
}

// ─── Props ───
type Props = Omit<ReservationEmailData, "to"> & {
  locale: string;
  t: EmailTranslator;
  whatsappNumber: string;
};

export function ReservationConfirmation({
  guestName,
  reservationId,
  tableNumber,
  reservationDate,
  guestsCount,
  locale,
  t,
  whatsappNumber,
}: Props) {
  const shortId = reservationId.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
  const dir = locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr";

  return (
    <Html dir={dir} lang={locale}>
      <Head />
      <Preview>{t("preview", { tableNumber })}</Preview>

      <Body style={body}>
        <Container style={container}>
          {/* ─── الترويسة ─── */}
          <Section style={header}>
            <Heading style={logo}>Lumière</Heading>
            <Text style={tagline}>{t("tagline")}</Text>
          </Section>

          {/* ─── المحتوى ─── */}
          <Section style={content}>
            <Heading as="h1" style={h1}>
              {t("greeting", { guestName })}
            </Heading>
            <Text style={paragraph}>{t("intro")}</Text>

            {/* ─── جدول التفاصيل ─── */}
            <Section style={detailsBox}>
              <DetailRow
                label={t("labelTableNumber")}
                value={t("valueTableNumber", { number: tableNumber })}
                highlight
              />
              <DetailRow
                label={t("labelGuestsCount")}
                value={t("valueGuestsCount", { count: guestsCount })}
              />
              <DetailRow
                label={t("labelDateTime")}
                value={formatLocalizedDate(reservationDate, locale)}
              />
              <DetailRow
                label={t("labelReservationId")}
                value={`#${shortId}`}
              />
            </Section>

            <Text style={paragraph}>{t("closing")}</Text>

            <Text style={paragraph}>
              {t("signatureRegards")}
              <br />
              <strong style={{ color: colors.accentDark }}>
                {t("signatureTeam")}
              </strong>
            </Text>

            <Hr style={hr} />

            {/* ─── زر Google Calendar ─── */}
            <Section style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 24 }}>
              <a
                href={generateGoogleCalendarLink({
                  title: t("calendarTitle", { tableNumber }),
                  description: [
                    t("calendarDescriptionGuests", { count: guestsCount }),
                    t("calendarDescriptionReservationId", { id: shortId }),
                  ].join("\n"),
                  location: t("calendarLocation"),
                  startDate: reservationDate,
                  durationMinutes: 90,
                })}
                style={{
                  display: "inline-block",
                  backgroundColor: colors.accent,
                  color: "#ffffff",
                  padding: "12px 28px",
                  borderRadius: "999px",
                  textDecoration: "none",
                  fontSize: "14px",
                  fontWeight: 600,
                }}
              >
                {t("calendarButton")}
              </a>
            </Section>

            <Hr style={hr} />

            {/* ─── التذييل ─── */}
            <Text style={footer}>
              {t("footerAutoMessage")}
              <br />
              {t("footerContact")}{" "}
              <span dir="ltr">+{whatsappNumber}</span>
            </Text>
          </Section>
        </Container>
      </Body>
    </Html>
  );
}

// ─── صف تفاصيل ───
function DetailRow({
  label,
  value,
  highlight,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  highlight?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <Section style={detailRow}>
      <Text style={detailLabel}>{label}</Text>
      <Text style={highlight ? detailValueHighlight : detailValue}>{value}</Text>
    </Section>
  );
}

    <section id="overview">
      <h2><span class="num">1</span> Overview</h2>
      <p><strong>Goal:</strong> Deploy the complete Lumière application — database, backend, frontend, and authentication — to a public URL with HTTPS.</p>
      <h3>Deliverables</h3>
      <ol>
        <li><strong>Git repository</strong> initialized with a clean <code>.gitignore</code> and committed to GitHub.</li>
        <li><strong>Neon PostgreSQL database</strong> provisioned a separate <code>lumiere_db</code> inside the existing project.</li>
        <li><strong>SQLite → PostgreSQL migration</strong> with updated Prisma schema and regenerated migrations.</li>
        <li><strong>Vercel deployment</strong> connected to the GitHub repository with auto-deploy on every push.</li>
        <li><strong>Environment variables</strong> configured for <code>DATABASE_URL</code>, <code>DIRECT_URL</code>, <code>AUTH_SECRET</code>, and <code>EMAIL_PROVIDER</code>.</li>
        <li><strong>Production URL live</strong> at <code>lumiere-nextjs-fullstack.vercel.app</code>.</li>
        <li><strong>Five production errors diagnosed</strong> and resolved with permanent fixes.</li>
      </ol>
    </section>

    <section id="architecture">
      <h2><span class="num">4</span> Deployment Architecture</h2>
      <div class="flow">
        <div class="flow-step">Local Machine · VS Code · npm run dev</div>
        <div class="flow-arrow"></div>
        <div class="flow-label">git push</div>

        <div class="flow-step code">GitHub · myhifi/lumiere-nextjs-fullstack</div>
        <div class="flow-arrow"></div>
        <div class="flow-label">Auto-deploy webhook</div>
        <div class="flow-arrow"></div>
        <div class="flow-step code">Vercel Build · next build --webpack</div>
        <div class="flow-arrow"></div>
        <div class="flow-label">postinstall → prisma generate</div>
        <div class="flow-arrow"></div>
        <div class="flow-step success">Production · lumiere-nextjs-fullstack.vercel.app</div>
        <div class="flow-arrow"></div>
        <div class="flow-label">Prisma query · Direct URL</div>
        <div class="flow-arrow"></div>
        <div class="flow-step code">Neon PostgreSQL · lumiere_db</div>
      </div>
      <p><strong>Every layer is automated:</strong> a single <code>git push</code> triggers the entire pipeline from code commit to live deployment in under 90 seconds.</p>

    <section id="commands">
      <h2><span class="num">5</span> Complete Commands Table</h2>
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Command</th><th>Purpose</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>1</td><td><code>git --version</code></td><td>Verify Git installation</td></tr>
          <tr><td>2</td><td><code>git remote -v</code></td><td>Check existing remote configuration</td></tr>
          <tr><td>3</td><td><code>git branch -M main</code></td><td>Rename master → main</td></tr>
          <tr><td>4</td><td><code>git remote add origin &lt;url&gt;</code></td><td>Connect local repo to GitHub</td></tr>
          <tr><td>5</td><td><code>git add -A</code></td><td>Stage all changes</td></tr>
          <tr><td>6</td><td><code>git commit -m "..."</code></td><td>Save with descriptive message</td></tr>
          <tr><td>7</td><td><code>git push -u origin main</code></td><td>Upload and set upstream tracking</td></tr>
          <tr><td>8</td><td><code>npx prisma migrate dev --name init_postgres</code></td><td>Create PostgreSQL migrations</td></tr>
          <tr><td>9</td><td><code>npm run db:seed</code></td><td>Seed the Neon database</td></tr>
          <tr><td>10</td><td><code>npm run db:admin</code></td><td>Create the first admin user</td></tr>
          <tr><td>11</td><td><code>npm install @prisma/adapter-neon @neondatabase/serverless</code></td><td>(Attempted) Neon serverless adapter — later reverted</td></tr>
          <tr><td>12</td><td><code>npx prisma generate</code></td><td>Regenerate Prisma Client after schema changes</td></tr>
          <tr><td>13</td><td><code>npm run dev -- --webpack</code></td><td>Run dev server with webpack</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <section id="git-setup">
      <h2><span class="num">6</span> Step 1: Git Setup</h2>
      <p><strong>Verify Git is installed:</strong></p>
      <pre><code>git --version
# git version 2.48.1.windows.1</code></pre>
      <p><strong>Check the .gitignore file</strong> — critical for keeping secrets out of the repository:</p>
      <pre><code># .gitignore (relevant entries)
/node_modules
.env*
/src/generated/prisma
email-preview.html
prisma/dev.db
prisma/dev.db-journal</code></pre>
      <div class="callout danger">
        <strong>Security verification</strong>
        Before any commit, run <code>git check-ignore .env</code>. If it returns <code>.env</code>, the file is safely excluded. If it returns nothing, STOP — the file would be uploaded and secrets would leak.
      </div>
      <p><strong>Rename branch and connect to GitHub:</strong></p>
      <pre><code>git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/myhifi/lumiere-nextjs-fullstack.git
git remote -v</code></pre>
    </section>

    <section id="github-push">
      <h2><span class="num">7</span> Step 2: GitHub Push</h2>
      <p><strong>First commit includes 104 files across the entire project:</strong></p>
      <div class="terminal">
        <div class="terminal-bar"><span class="terminal-dot red"></span><span class="terminal-dot yellow"></span><span class="terminal-dot green"></span></div>
        <div class="terminal-body">
          <div class="out"><span class="cmd">&gt;</span> git add -A</div>
          <div class="out"><span class="cmd">&gt;</span> git commit -m "Phase 1-8: Full-stack Lumière"</div>
          <div class="out">[main 675428b] Phase 1-8: Full-stack Lumière...</div>
          <div class="out"> 104 files changed, 15632 insertions(+), 189 deletions(-)</div>
          <div class="out">&nbsp;</div>
          <div class="out"><span class="cmd">&gt;</span> git push -u origin main</div>
          <div class="out">Writing objects: 100% (185/185), <span class="ok">261.41 KiB</span> | 605.00 KiB/s</div>
          <div class="out">To https://github.com/myhifi/lumiere-nextjs-fullstack.git</div>
          <div class="out"> * [new branch]      main -&gt; main</div>
          <div class="out">branch 'main' set up to track 'origin/main'.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="callout success">
        <strong>Only 261 KB uploaded</strong>
        Because <code>.gitignore</code> correctly excluded <code>node_modules</code> (500+ MB) and <code>src/generated/prisma</code> (21 MB), the entire repository weighs less than a single high-resolution image. Mobile data bundles easily handle this.
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="neon">
      <h2><span class="num">8</span> Step 3: Neon Database</h2>
      <p><strong>Existing Neon project reused:</strong> Instead of consuming a new free-tier project slot, a new database was created inside the existing <code>neon-cordovan-basket</code> project.</p>
      <h3>Why a separate database, not a separate project?</h3>
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>Resource</th><th>Hobby tier limit</th><th>Our usage</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Projects per account</td><td>1</td><td>1 (existing)</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Databases per project</td><td>10</td><td>2 (existing + <code>lumiere_db</code>)</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Storage total</td><td>0.5 GB</td><td>~0.04 GB</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <div class="callout info">
        <strong>Portfolio architecture benefit</strong>
      </div>
      <h3>Connection string anatomy</h3>
      <pre><code>postgresql://neondb_owner:YOUR_PASSWORD@
  ep-delicate-queen-api0jkos.c-7.us-east-1.aws.neon.tech/
  lumiere_db?sslmode=require&amp;connect_timeout=30
                    ↑↑↑↑↑↑↑↑↑↑
                    database name</code></pre>
      <p><strong>Two connection endpoints matter:</strong></p>
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>Endpoint</th><th>Hostname suffix</th><th>Used for</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Direct</td><td><code>.c-7.us-east-1.aws.neon.tech</code></td><td>Migrations · Local dev · Serverless runtime (chosen)</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Pooled</td><td><code>-pooler.c-7.us-east-1.aws.neon.tech</code></td><td>Long-running servers with many connections (rejected)</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <section id="migration">
      <h2><span class="num">9</span> Step 4: SQLite → PostgreSQL Migration</h2>
      <p><strong>Three files changed, one migration regenerated:</strong></p>
      <div class="filetree">
        <div><span class="dir">prisma/</span></div>
        <div class="indent-1"><span class="file upd">schema.prisma</span> <span class="note">← provider: sqlite → postgresql</span></div>
        <div class="indent-1"><span class="dir">migrations/</span></div>
        <div class="indent-2"><span class="file">20260924125523_init_postgres/migration.sql</span> <span class="note">← NEW</span></div>
        <div><span class="dir">src/lib/</span></div>
        <div class="indent-1"><span class="file upd">prisma.ts</span> <span class="note">← simplified, no SQLite path logic</span></div>
        <div><span class="file upd">.env</span> <span class="note">← DATABASE_URL switched to Neon</span></div>
      </div>
      <h3>Schema change</h3>
      <pre><code>datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"    // was "sqlite"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider      = "prisma-client-js"    // classic import path
  binaryTargets = ["native", "rhel-openssl-3.0.x"]
}</code></pre>
      <h3>Prisma client simplification</h3>
      <pre><code>// Before (SQLite — needed absolute path)
import path from 'node:path';
const sqlitePath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'prisma', 'dev.db');

// After (PostgreSQL — direct URL from env)
import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
export const prisma = globalForPrisma.prisma ?? new PrismaClient();</code></pre>
    </section>

    <section id="vercel-connect">
      <h2><span class="num">10</span> Step 5: Vercel Connect</h2>
      <p><strong>Import flow from the Vercel dashboard:</strong></p>
      <ol>
        <li>Click <strong>Add New</strong> → <strong>Project</strong>.</li>
        <li>Select the GitHub repository <code>lumiere-nextjs-fullstack</code>.</li>
        <li>Confirm <strong>Framework Preset = Next.js</strong> (auto-detected).</li>
        <li>Leave <strong>Root Directory</strong> as <code>./</code>.</li>
        <li>Add the four environment variables before clicking Deploy.</li>
        <li>Do <strong>not</strong> enable the Optional Integrations — they would override manual configuration.</li>
      </ol>
      <div class="callout warn">
        <strong>Trap avoided</strong>
        Vercel offers "Prisma Postgres" and "Resend email" integrations in the setup page. Both would create <em>new</em> accounts and override the manually configured values. Manual configuration gives full control.
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="env-vars">
      <h2><span class="num">11</span> Step 6: Environment Variables</h2>
      <p><strong>The four variables required on Vercel:</strong></p>
      <div class="config-grid">
        <div class="config-card">
          <div class="config-key">DATABASE_URL</div>
          <div class="config-value">postgresql://neondb_owner:••••@ep-delicate-queen-api0jkos.c-7.us-east-1.aws.neon.tech/lumiere_db?sslmode=require&amp;connect_timeout=30</div>
          <div class="config-note">Direct endpoint — no -pooler</div>
        </div>
        <div class="config-card">
          <div class="config-key">DIRECT_URL</div>
          <div class="config-value">Same as DATABASE_URL</div>
          <div class="config-note">For migrations (not used in serverless runtime)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="config-card">
          <div class="config-key">AUTH_SECRET</div>
          <div class="config-value">(64-char random string)</div>
          <div class="config-note">Generated locally with crypto.randomBytes</div>
        </div>
        <div class="config-card">
          <div class="config-key">EMAIL_PROVIDER</div>
          <div class="config-value">console</div>
          <div class="config-note">Logs to Vercel Functions logs</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="callout danger">
        <strong>Why direct URL and not pooler?</strong>
        Vercel Serverless functions establish short-lived connections. Neon's PgBouncer pooler, designed for long-lived connections, was refusing these short-lived handshakes with <code>P1001</code>. Direct endpoint works flawlessly. For low-traffic portfolios, direct connections consume only 1–3 of the 100-connection limit.
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="first-deploy">
      <h2><span class="num">12</span> Step 7: First Deploy</h2>
      <p><strong>Package.json scripts that made it work:</strong></p>
      <pre><code>"scripts": {
  "dev":   "next dev --webpack",
  "build": "next build --webpack",
  "start": "next start",
  "lint":  "eslint",
  "postinstall": "prisma generate",
  "db:seed":  "tsx prisma/seed.ts",
  "db:admin": "tsx scripts/create-admin.ts"
}</code></pre>
      <h3>Why each flag matters</h3>
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>Element</th><th>Reason</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td><code>--webpack</code> on <code>dev</code> and <code>build</code></td><td>Forces Next.js to use Webpack instead of Turbopack — required because <code>PrismaPlugin</code> only works with Webpack</td></tr>
          <tr><td><code>postinstall: prisma generate</code></td><td>Ensures Prisma Client exists on Vercel after <code>npm install</code> — the <code>src/generated</code> folder is gitignored</td></tr>
          <tr><td><code>binaryTargets: ["native", "rhel-openssl-3.0.x"]</code></td><td>Downloads both Windows and Linux engines — Linux engine is required on Vercel's Amazon Linux runtime</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <section id="errors">
      <h2><span class="num">13</span> The 5 Errors Journey</h2>
      <p>Production deployment revealed <strong>five distinct errors</strong> — each requiring a different fix. This is the complete timeline.</p>
      <div class="error-journey">
        <div class="error-item solved">
          <h4>🎯 Error 1: Missing force-dynamic</h4>
          <div class="error-msg">Error occurred prerendering page "/" · Can't reach database server</div>
          <div class="error-fix"><strong>Fix:</strong> Add <code>export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"</code> to DB-driven pages.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="error-item solved">
          <h4>🎯 Error 2: TypeScript Declaration Missing</h4>
          <div class="error-msg">Could not find a declaration file for module '@prisma/nextjs-monorepo-workaround-plugin'</div>
          <div class="error-fix"><strong>Fix:</strong> Create <code>src/types/prisma-plugin.d.ts</code> with <code>declare module</code>.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="error-item solved">
          <h4>🎯 Error 3: Turbopack vs Webpack Conflict</h4>
          <div class="error-msg">This build is using Turbopack, with a `webpack` config and no `turbopack` config</div>
          <div class="error-fix"><strong>Fix:</strong> Add <code>--webpack</code> flag to both dev and build scripts.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="error-item solved">
          <h4>🎯 Error 4: Query Engine Missing on Vercel</h4>
          <div class="error-msg">Prisma Client could not locate the Query Engine for runtime "rhel-openssl-3.0.x"</div>
          <div class="error-fix"><strong>Fix:</strong> Switch from <code>prisma-client</code> to <code>prisma-client-js</code> generator.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="error-item solved">
          <h4>🎯 Error 5: Pooler Failure</h4>
          <div class="error-msg">Can't reach database server at `ep-delicate-queen-api0jkos-pooler.c-7.us-east-1.aws.neon.tech:5432`</div>
          <div class="error-fix"><strong>Fix:</strong> Replace <code>-pooler</code> hostname with direct endpoint in Vercel env vars.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="error-1">
      <h2><span class="num">14</span> Error 1: force-dynamic</h2>
      <p><strong>Symptom:</strong></p>
      <pre><code>⨯ Error [PrismaClientInitializationError]:
  Can't reach database server at `ep-delicate-queen-api0jkos-pooler...`
  at async i (src/app/(public)/page.tsx:7:25)
Export encountered an error on /(public)/page: /, exiting the build.</code></pre>
      <p><strong>Root cause:</strong> Next.js tried to prerender the homepage at build time — querying the database during deployment. Neon refused the connection because it was cold.</p>
      <p><strong>Fix:</strong> Add <code>export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"</code> to every page that queries the database.</p>
      <pre><code>// src/app/(public)/page.tsx
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";    // ← added

export default async function HomePage() {
  const featuredItems = await prisma.menuItem.findMany(...);
  ...
}</code></pre>
      <div class="callout success">
        <strong>Result</strong>
        Pages render on-demand instead of at build. First visitor triggers the DB query; subsequent visitors hit cached HTML.
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="error-2">
      <h2><span class="num">15</span> Error 2: TypeScript Declaration</h2>
      <p><strong>Symptom:</strong></p>
      <pre><code>Could not find a declaration file for module 
'@prisma/nextjs-monorepo-workaround-plugin'.</code></pre>
      <p><strong>Root cause:</strong> The plugin has no TypeScript type definitions, so the import statement failed during <code>next build</code>'s type check.</p>
      <p><strong>Fix:</strong> Create a declaration file.</p>
      <pre><code>// src/types/prisma-plugin.d.ts
declare module "@prisma/nextjs-monorepo-workaround-plugin";</code></pre>
      <div class="callout">
        <strong>Pattern for future use</strong>
        Whenever a third-party library lacks types, create a one-line <code>.d.ts</code> file under <code>src/types/</code> with <code>declare module "library-name"</code>.
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="error-3">
      <h2><span class="num">16</span> Error 3: Turbopack vs Webpack</h2>
      <p><strong>Symptom:</strong></p>
      <pre><code>⨯ ERROR: This build is using Turbopack, with a `webpack` config 
   and no `turbopack` config.
   This may be a mistake.</code></pre>
      <p><strong>Root cause:</strong> Next.js 16 defaults to Turbopack. Turbopack cannot use the <code>webpack()</code> function from <code>next.config.ts</code> where <code>PrismaPlugin</code> is injected. The two build systems are fundamentally incompatible.</p>
      <p><strong>Fix:</strong> Force Webpack in both dev and production.</p>
      <pre><code>"scripts": {
  "dev":   "next dev --webpack",
  "build": "next build --webpack"
}</code></pre>
      <div class="callout warn">
        <strong>Trade-off</strong>
        Webpack builds are ~10–15 seconds slower than Turbopack but are the only way to run custom <code>webpack()</code> configuration — required for <code>PrismaPlugin</code>.
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="error-4">
      <h2><span class="num">17</span> Error 4: Query Engine Missing</h2>
      <p><strong>Symptom:</strong></p>
      <pre><code>Prisma Client could not locate the Query Engine for runtime "rhel-openssl-3.0.x".
...
Ensure that "libquery_engine-rhel-openssl-3.0.x.so.node" 
has been copied to ".next/server/chunks".

The following locations have been searched:
  /var/task/.next/server/chunks
  /vercel/path0/src/generated/prisma
  /tmp/prisma-engines</code></pre>
      <p><strong>Root cause:</strong> The <code>prisma-client</code> generator (Prisma 6's newer style) outputs to a custom directory <code>src/generated/prisma/</code>. Next.js excludes this directory from build outputs because it's gitignored. The Linux <code>.so.node</code> binary never reached the Vercel runtime.</p>
      <p><strong>Fix:</strong> Switch to the classic <code>prisma-client-js</code> generator, which outputs to <code>node_modules/@prisma/client/</code> — a directory Next.js automatically includes in builds.</p>
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>Generator</th><th>Output</th><th>Vercel Bundle</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td><code>prisma-client</code></td><td><code>src/generated/prisma/</code> (gitignored)</td><td>❌ Missing engine</td></tr>
          <tr><td><code>prisma-client-js</code></td><td><code>node_modules/.prisma/client/</code> (auto-bundled)</td><td>✅ Engine included</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <pre><code>generator client {
  provider      = "prisma-client-js"
  binaryTargets = ["native", "rhel-openssl-3.0.x"]
}</code></pre>
      <h3>Required import changes</h3>
      <p>All files that imported from <code>../generated/prisma/client</code> had to switch to <code>@prisma/client</code>:</p>
      <ul>
        <li><code>prisma/seed.ts</code></li>
        <li><code>scripts/create-admin.ts</code></li>
        <li><code>src/lib/prisma.ts</code></li>
      </ul>
    </section>

    <section id="error-5">
      <h2><span class="num">18</span> Error 5: Pooler Failure</h2>
      <p><strong>Symptom (runtime, after successful build):</strong></p>
      <pre><code>prisma:error 
Invalid `prisma.menuItem.findMany()` invocation:

Can't reach database server at 
`ep-delicate-queen-api0jkos-pooler.c-7.us-east-1.aws.neon.tech:5432`</code></pre>
      <p><strong>Root cause:</strong> The <code>-pooler</code> hostname uses PgBouncer, which is optimized for long-lived connections (traditional server deployments). Vercel Serverless opens and closes connections per request. PgBouncer rejects the rapid handshake sequence with a <code>P1001</code> timeout.</p>
      <p><strong>Diagnostic confirmation:</strong></p>
      <ul>
        <li>Neon dashboard showed compute as <strong>ACTIVE</strong> — not a cold start.</li>
        <li>Local development with direct URL worked perfectly.</li>
        <li>Only Vercel (serverless) failed on the pooled endpoint.</li>
      </ul>
      <p><strong>Fix:</strong> Update Vercel's environment variables to use the direct endpoint.</p>
      <div class="config-grid">
        <div class="config-card">
          <div class="config-key">❌ Broken (Pooled)</div>
          <div class="config-value">ep-delicate-queen-api0jkos-pooler.c-7.us-east-1.aws.neon.tech</div>
        </div>
        <div class="config-card">
          <div class="config-key">✅ Working (Direct)</div>
          <div class="config-value">ep-delicate-queen-api0jkos.c-7.us-east-1.aws.neon.tech</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="callout success">
        <strong>Why this works for low-traffic portfolios</strong>
        Direct connections consume 1–3 of Neon's 100-connection limit. For a portfolio site with occasional visitors, this is negligible. Pooler becomes necessary only at high concurrency.
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="final-config">
      <h2><span class="num">19</span> Final Working Configuration</h2>

    <section id="pitfalls">
      <h2><span class="num">21</span> Common Pitfalls &amp; Fixes</h2>
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>Pitfall</th><th>Symptom</th><th>Fix</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>Committing <code>.env</code></td><td>Secrets on public GitHub</td><td>Add to <code>.gitignore</code> before first commit</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Committing <code>prisma/dev.db</code></td><td>Binary file bloats repo</td><td>Add <code>prisma/dev.db</code> to <code>.gitignore</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Prerendered DB pages</td><td>Build fails: can't reach DB</td><td><code>export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Missing TypeScript declaration</td><td><code>Could not find declaration file</code></td><td>Create <code>src/types/plugin.d.ts</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Turbopack + Webpack conflict</td><td>Build error immediately</td><td>Add <code>--webpack</code> flag to scripts</td></tr>
          <tr><td><code>prisma-client</code> generator</td><td><code>Query Engine not found</code> on Vercel</td><td>Switch to <code>prisma-client-js</code></td></tr>
          <tr><td>Pooled connection on serverless</td><td><code>P1001</code> at runtime</td><td>Use direct endpoint</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Vercel integrations override config</td><td>Wrong DB URL, wrong email provider</td><td>Skip Optional Integrations</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Neon compute suspended</td><td>First request slow or 500</td><td>Wait 5–8s or upgrade tier</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </section>

    <section id="glossary">
      <h2><span class="num">23</span> Technical Abbreviations Glossary</h2>
      <table>
        <thead><tr><th>Abbr.</th><th>Full Form</th><th>Plain-English Meaning</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td>CDN</td><td>Content Delivery Network</td><td>Globally distributed cache servers</td></tr>
          <tr><td>CI/CD</td><td>Continuous Integration / Deployment</td><td>Automated pipeline from commit to production</td></tr>
          <tr><td>CLI</td><td>Command-Line Interface</td><td>Programs operated by typing commands</td></tr>
          <tr><td>DNS</td><td>Domain Name System</td><td>Translates domain names to IP addresses</td></tr>
          <tr><td>HTTPS</td><td>HTTP Secure</td><td>Encrypted HTTP via TLS</td></tr>
          <tr><td>ORM</td><td>Object-Relational Mapper</td><td>Code layer translating objects ↔ SQL</td></tr>
          <tr><td>PgBouncer</td><td>PostgreSQL Connection Pooler</td><td>Manages many client connections over fewer DB connections</td></tr>
          <tr><td>RHEL</td><td>Red Hat Enterprise Linux</td><td>Base OS for Amazon Linux on Vercel</td></tr>
          <tr><td>SSL/TLS</td><td>Secure Sockets Layer / Transport Layer Security</td><td>Encryption for network traffic</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Serverless</td><td>—</td><td>Execution model where the provider manages servers</td></tr>
          <tr><td>URL</td><td>Uniform Resource Locator</td><td>Web address</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Vercel</td><td>—</td><td>Hosting platform created by the Next.js team</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>

<file path="next.config.ts">
import type { NextConfig } from "next";
import { PrismaPlugin } from "@prisma/nextjs-monorepo-workaround-plugin";
import createNextIntlPlugin from "next-intl/plugin";

const withNextIntl = createNextIntlPlugin("./src/i18n/request.ts");

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  webpack: (config, { isServer }) => {
    if (isServer) {
      config.plugins = [...config.plugins, new PrismaPlugin()];
    }
    return config;
  },
  images: {
    remotePatterns: [
      { protocol: "https", hostname: "images.unsplash.com" },
      { protocol: "https", hostname: "source.unsplash.com" },
      { protocol: "https", hostname: "flagcdn.com" }, // <-- إضافة جديدة
    ],
  },
};

export default withNextIntl(nextConfig);
</file>

<file path="prisma/schema.prisma">
// هذا هو ملف مخطط قاعدة البيانات لمشروع Lumière Restaurant
// كل جدول نكتبه هنا، سيصبح جدولاً حقيقياً في قاعدة البيانات
// المرجع: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider      = "prisma-client-js"
  binaryTargets = ["native", "rhel-openssl-3.0.x"]
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 📂 Category — تصنيفات الأطباق
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
model Category {
  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  name         String     @unique
  nameEn       String?    @unique
  slug         String     @unique
  description  String?
  displayOrder Int        @default(0)
  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt

  // 🔗 Relation: one category → many items
  items        MenuItem[]

  @@map("categories")
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 🍽️ MenuItem — الأطباق
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
model MenuItem {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  name           String
  nameEn         String?
  slug           String   @unique
  description    String?
  descriptionEn  String?
  price          Float
  imageUrl    String?
  isAvailable Boolean  @default(true)
  isFeatured  Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  // 🔗 العلاقة: كل طبق ينتمي لتصنيف واحد
  categoryId  String
  category    Category @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("menu_items")
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 🪑 Table — طاولات المطعم
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
model Table {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  number       Int      @unique
  capacity     Int
  location     String?
  isActive     Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  // 🔗 العلاقة: طاولة واحدة → حجوزات كثيرة
  reservations Reservation[]

  @@map("tables")
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 📅 Reservation — الحجوزات
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
model Reservation {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  guestName       String
  guestEmail      String
  guestPhone      String
  guestsCount     Int
  reservationDate DateTime
  durationMinutes Int      @default(90)
  status          String   @default("PENDING")
  notes           String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  // 🔗 العلاقة: كل حجز مرتبط بطاولة واحدة
  tableId String
  table   Table  @relation(fields: [tableId], references: [id])

  @@map("reservations")
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 👤 User — مستخدمو لوحة التحكم (مسؤولون وموظفون)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
model User {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  email        String   @unique
  passwordHash String
  name         String
  role         String   @default("STAFF")
  isActive     Boolean  @default(true)
  lastLoginAt  DateTime?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("users")
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 📋 AuditLog — سجل الإجراءات (لمساءلة الموظفين)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// يُسجّل الإجراءات الحساسة التي يقوم بها الموظفون فقط.
//
// ⚠️ **قرار معماري مهم:**
//   • لا علاقة (`relation`) مع `User` — عن قصد.
//   • السجل يجب أن يبقى صامداً حتى لو حُذف المستخدم.
//   • نُخزّن `userName` كـ snapshot وقت الإجراء.
//   • نُخزّن `entityName` كـ snapshot وقت الإجراء.
//
// `severity` للفلترة السريعة:
//   • info     → إجراءات عادية (إنشاء/تعديل)
//   • warning  → إجراءات حساسة (تعطيل/إلغاء)
//   • critical → إجراءات خطيرة (حذف)

model AuditLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())

  // ─── من فعل الإجراء؟ ───
  userId     String?  // null لو حُذف المستخدم
  userName   String   // snapshot وقت الإجراء

  // ─── ماذا حدث؟ ───
  action     String   // "CREATE" | "UPDATE" | "DELETE"
  entity     String   // "MenuItem" | "Table" | "User" | "Reservation"
  entityId   String
  entityName String   // snapshot وقت الإجراء

  // ─── تفاصيل التغيير ───
  severity   String   @default("info")  // info | warning | critical
  changes    Json?    // { before: {...}, after: {...} }

  // ─── متى؟ ───
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  // ─── فهارس للفلترة السريعة ───
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([severity])
  @@index([entity])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ⭐ Review — تقييمات العملاء
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ⚠️ لا علاقة بـ `Reservation` — العميل لا يحتاج حجزاً سابقاً.
// (التقييمات المرتبطة بالحجز = ميزة "Review Invitations" في Roadmap)

model Review {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())

  // ─── بيانات العميل ───
  guestName   String
  guestEmail  String?  // اختياري — للإدارة فقط، لا يُعرَض

  // ─── التقييم ───
  rating      Int      // 1..5 نجوم
  comment     String

  // ─── الحالة ───
  status      String   @default("PENDING")  // PENDING | APPROVED | REJECTED

  // ─── تواريخ ───
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  // ─── فهارس للفلترة السريعة ───
  @@index([status])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("reviews")
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ⚙️ Setting — site-wide key/value settings
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
model Setting {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  key       String   @unique
  value     String
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@map("settings")
}

# 🍽️ Lumière Restaurant — Full-Stack Next.js Application

> A production-ready, bilingual (Arabic + English), 7-locale restaurant platform with an intelligent table-assignment engine, a zero-download Smart FAQ Assistant, complete admin dashboard, authentication, email notifications, and About page. Built with Next.js 16, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. Deployed on Vercel. Full RTL/LTR support.

[![Live Demo](https://img.shields.io/badge/Live-Demo-c9a961?style=for-the-badge&logo=vercel)](https://lumiere-nextjs-fullstack.vercel.app)

## 🤖 Smart FAQ Assistant

A floating chat panel that answers common restaurant questions in **all 7 supported languages** — with **zero external API**, **zero download**, and **sub-50ms responses**.

**How it works:**
- The user types a question in any language (`what time do you open?`, `إيه مواعيد العمل؟`, `营业时间是什么？`)
- A pure TypeScript **intent matcher** scores the query against 10 keyword lists (one per intent)
- The winning intent's response is pulled from the current locale's translation file
- The whole thing runs server-side as a Next.js **Server Action** — no LLM, no third-party service

**Coverage:** `hours` · `location` · `parking` · `reservation` · `cancel` · `menu` · `allergies` · `vegetarian` · `halal` · `events`

**Why not an LLM:** The Assistant is self-contained and deterministic — no API keys, no rate limits, no third-party dependency. A keyword matcher delivers fast, predictable answers in ~200 lines of code, and stays under 50 ms.

## ✨ Features

### Customer-Facing

- 🍽️ **Menu browsing** with category filtering (4 categories, 12 dishes)
- 🔍 **Item detail pages** with dynamic routing and rich descriptions
- 📅 **Smart reservation engine** — auto-assigns the optimal table based on party size, time slot, and existing bookings (interval-overlap algorithm)
- 📧 **Email confirmation** on reservation (console provider in development)
- 💬 **WhatsApp integration** — floating button on every page
- 🌍 **7 languages** — Arabic, English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Chinese — with automatic RTL/LTR direction switching
- 🎨 **Bilingual content** — menu items and categories have Arabic + English names, with graceful fallback in the other 3 locales
- 📖 **About page** — the story of Lumière, chef biography, values, and full-page storytelling in 7 locales
- 🤖 **Smart FAQ Assistant** — floating chat panel that answers common questions in all 7 languages. Zero download, zero external API, sub-50ms responses
- ⭐ **Customer reviews** — star ratings with admin moderation
- ⬆️ **Scroll-to-top button** — appears after 400px of scrolling, elegant fade-in
- 📱 **Fully responsive** — mobile-first design with three breakpoints

### Admin Dashboard

- 📊 **Dashboard overview** with real-time statistics
- 📅 **Reservations management** — status lifecycle: pending → confirmed → completed (or cancelled)
- 🍽️ **Menu management** — full CRUD with availability toggle, featured toggle, auto-slugs, and bilingual fields
- 📂 **Categories management** — with cascade-delete protection
- 🪑 **Tables management** — with reservation-history protection
- 👥 **Users management** — role-based access (ADMIN/STAFF) with three-tier safety rules
- ⭐ **Reviews moderation** — approve, reject, or delete customer reviews
- 📋 **Audit Log** — tracks every staff action (create/update/delete) with before/after diffs, severity levels (info/warning/critical), and filtering by entity or severity
- 📊 **Analytics Dashboard** — interactive donut and bar charts (Recharts) showing category distribution, price ranges, and featured balance
- 🔐 **Authentication** — Auth.js v5 with credentials, bcrypt hashing, JWT sessions
- 🌍 **Fully translated admin** — every label, button, and error message localized in 5 languages

### Engineering

- ⚡ **Server Components** — zero client JavaScript for static content
- 🔒 **Defense-in-depth security** — five layers from client to business rule
- ✅ **Zod validation** — cross-field refinements, per-locale error messages via schema factories
- 🎯 **Auto-scroll to first error** — reusable hook applied to all 6 forms for accessible validation UX
- 🌐 **Per-locale SEO** — 80-URL sitemap (16 pages × 5 locales), locale-aware robots.txt, hreflang links
- 🔄 **Auto-deploy** — one `git push` triggers full CI/CD pipeline
- 📱 **Responsive** — mobile-first with three breakpoints
- ♿ **Accessibility** — ARIA labels, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus management

---

## 🏗️ Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **Framework** | Next.js 16 (App Router) | Full-stack framework |
| **Language** | TypeScript 5 | Type safety across the stack |
| **Database** | PostgreSQL 17 (Neon) | Serverless relational database |
| **ORM** | Prisma 6 | Type-safe database client |
| **Validation** | Zod 4 | Runtime schema validation |
| **i18n** | next-intl 4 | 7-locale routing and messages |
| **Assistant** | Pure TS intent matcher | Zero-dependency FAQ chatbot |
| **Styling** | Tailwind CSS 4 | Utility-first CSS with RTL support |
| **Auth** | Auth.js v5 (NextAuth) | Credential-based authentication |
| **Charts** | Recharts | Interactive analytics dashboards |
| **Email** | React Email | Transactional email templates |
| **Hosting** | Vercel | Serverless deployment with CDN |
| **Source Control** | GitHub | Version control and CI/CD |

---

## 🗺️ Architecture
```
Browser
│
├── Public pages → Server Components → Prisma → PostgreSQL
├── Reservation form → Server Action → Smart engine → Prisma
├── About page → Server Component → i18n messages
├── Smart Assistant → Server Action → Intent matcher → i18n messages
└── Admin dashboard → Auth.js + RBAC → Server Actions → Prisma
Deployment:
Git push → GitHub → Vercel Build → Production URL
```


### Key Architectural Decisions

- **Single codebase** — Next.js handles both frontend and backend
- **Server Components by default** — only interactive leaves become Client Components
- **Pure business logic** — `findBestTable()` has no knowledge of HTTP or the database
- **Server Actions over API routes** — for internal mutations
- **Route Handlers for external consumers** — `/api/menu/*` for third parties
- **Locale-prefixed routing** — every URL carries its language (`/en/menu`, `/ar/menu`)
- **Bilingual content strategy** — Arabic + English in the DB, with graceful fallback for FR/DE/ES
- **Schema factories** — Zod schemas receive a translator and return localized errors
- **Self-contained assistant** — Smart FAQ uses a pure TypeScript intent matcher. Deterministic, sub-50ms responses, works in all 7 locales.

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18.17+ (recommended: 20+)
- npm 9+
- A PostgreSQL database (Neon recommended)

### Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/myhifi/lumiere-nextjs-fullstack.git
cd lumiere-nextjs-fullstack

npm install

cp .env.example .env
# Fill in DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, AUTH_SECRET

npx prisma migrate dev

npm run db:seed

npm run db:admin

npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:3000 in your browser.

---
### Demo Access

For portfolio review, use this account to explore the full admin dashboard:

- **Email:** `demo@lumiere.com`
- **Password:** `Demo2026!`

> ⚠️ **Demo mode:** This account is provided for portfolio review only. All changes are automatically reset every 6 hours to preserve the demo experience. The production admin account is not published.

## 🔐 Environment Variables

| Variable | Purpose | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL connection string (direct endpoint) | ✅ |
| `DIRECT_URL` | Direct connection for migrations | ✅ |
| `AUTH_SECRET` | JWT signing secret (64+ chars) | ✅ |
| `EMAIL_PROVIDER` | `console` (dev) or `resend` (production) | ✅ |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` | Public URL for OG images and sitemap | Optional |

Generate `AUTH_SECRET` with:

```bash
node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))"

```

## 📁 Project Structure

```
lumiere-nextjs-fullstack/
├── messages/                     # 5 translation files (ar, en, fr, de, es)
├── public/
│   ├── portfolio/                # 12 HTML portfolio pages
│   └── screenshots/              # Curated screenshots (public, admin, docs)
├── prisma/
│   ├── schema.prisma             # 8 models (incl. AuditLog, Review)
│   ├── migrations/               # Versioned migrations
│   ├── seed.ts                   # Seed script
│   └── data/                     # Seed data (categories, items, tables)
├── scripts/
│   ├── create-admin.ts           # Idempotent admin seeder
│   ├── update-categories.ts      # Backfill EN category names
│   ├── update-menu-items-en.ts   # Backfill EN menu item names
│   └── test-*.ts                 # Test scripts for pure functions
├── src/
│   ├── actions/                  # 6 Server Action files
│   ├── app/
│   │   ├── [locale]/             # Locale-prefixed routes
│   │   │   ├── (auth)/           # Login page (centered layout)
│   │   │   ├── (public)/         # Home, Menu, Reserve, Review, About
│   │   │   └── admin/            # Protected admin dashboard
│   │   ├── api/                  # Route Handlers
│   │   ├── layout.tsx            # Passthrough root layout
│   │   ├── not-found.tsx         # Bilingual root 404
│   │   ├── opengraph-image.tsx   # Dynamic OG image
│   │   ├── robots.ts             # Per-locale robots.txt
│   │   └── sitemap.ts            # Per-locale sitemap.xml
│   ├── components/               # React components (mostly Server Components)
│   ├── i18n/                     # next-intl config (routing, request, navigation)
│   ├── lib/
│   │   ├── auth/                 # bcrypt utilities
│   │   ├── email/                # Email subsystem (Strategy Pattern)
│   │   ├── hooks/                # useScrollToFirstError
│   │   ├── services/             # Pure business logic
│   │   ├── utils/                # Helpers (getLocalizedName, tError)
│   │   └── validations/          # Zod schemas (factories)
│   ├── types/                    # TypeScript augmentations
│   ├── auth.config.ts            # Edge-safe Auth.js config
│   ├── auth.ts                   # Node-only Auth.js config
│   └── proxy.ts                  # Route protection + i18n middleware
└── package.json
```

## 🧪 Testing

The project includes test scripts for pure business logic:

```bash
npx tsx scripts/test-assignment.ts    # 5 table-assignment scenarios

npx tsx scripts/test-validation.ts    # 7 Zod validation scenarios

npx tsx scripts/test-password.ts      # 5 bcrypt scenarios

npx tsx scripts/test-email.ts         # 5-locale email rendering
```

All scripts print pass/fail for each scenario and exit with a non-zero code on failure.
